items.question: When a publish attempt is refused after its whole-graph save, what should the server keep as the stored draft?
options: Reset the stored draft to the latest published graph (or the blank authoring graph when only v1 exists), so the read never shows unpublished content
Keep the refused graph as the stored draft, shown in the read as a refused, unpublished attempt with who saved it and when, until the next save replaces it

evidence: comment 6222206213: round 1 ready, C1Q1 answered by option A
